# Mid-Michigan NOW

> Mid-Michigan NOW is a regional news outlet providing breaking news, weather, sports, and investigative journalism for the Flint-Saginaw area and Michigan.

The site covers local and national news with specialized series on crime investigations, education crises, business developments, and community events. Mid-Michigan NOW serves as the primary news hub for central Michigan residents seeking breaking news, weather forecasts, and in-depth regional reporting.

## Key Topics

- Flint, Michigan
- Saginaw
- Mid-Michigan region
- Breaking news
- Local news
- Crime reporting
- Flint water crisis
- Education/schools
- Weather
- Community events
- National news
- Cold cases
- Business development
- Regional coverage

## Core News Hubs

- [Homepage](https://midmichigannow.com): Homepage for Mid-Michigan NOW covering breaking news, weather, sports in Flint-Saginaw area
- [Local News](https://midmichigannow.com/news/local): Local news hub for Mid-Michigan covering breaking news, crime, and community events
- [Nation & World](https://midmichigannow.com/news/nation-world): National and international news coverage including politics, government, and world affairs
- [Videos](https://midmichigannow.com/news/videos): Video archive of news coverage including political, national, and breaking news stories

## Investigative & Special Series

- [Flint Water Crisis](https://midmichigannow.com/news/flint-water-crisis): Coverage of Flint water crisis including lead contamination, settlements, and remediation
- [Unsolved Mid-Michigan](https://midmichigannow.com/news/unsolved-mid-michigan): Investigation series on cold cases and unsolved crimes in Flint and Mid-Michigan region
- [Crisis in the Classroom](https://midmichigannow.com/news/crisis-in-the-classroom): Coverage of Michigan education crisis including teacher shortages and student mental health
- [Connect to Congress](https://midmichigannow.com/news/connect-to-congress): Congressional news and political coverage featuring lawmakers' votes and policy updates

## Community & Business Features

- [New In Town](https://midmichigannow.com/news/new-in-town): Feature series on new businesses opening in Mid-Michigan including Popeyes and local restaurants
- [We're Open](https://midmichigannow.com/news/were-open): Series spotlighting local businesses reopening in Downtown Flint and Mid-Michigan area
- [Digital Desk](https://midmichigannow.com/news/digital-desk): Digital content hub featuring weather forecasts, sports coverage, and episodic video series

## Lifestyle & Entertainment

- [Amazing America](https://midmichigannow.com/amazing-america): Travel and tourism series featuring American destinations and cultural landmarks
- [Entertainment](https://midmichigannow.com/news/entertainment): Entertainment news featuring celebrity gossip, movies, TV shows, and celebrity interviews
- [Armstrong Army Strong](https://midmichigannow.com/news/armstrong-army-strong): Opinion column by Armstrong Williams featuring political commentary and cultural analysis

## Audience Engagement

- [Stay Connected](https://midmichigannow.com/news/stay-connected): Hub for mobile app, social media, newsletters, and news distribution channels

## Optional

- [Offbeat](https://midmichigannow.com/news/offbeat): Light-hearted offbeat news featuring animal stories, quirky events, and human interest
- [The Dog Guy: Carl Liepmann Profile](https://midmichigannow.com/news/local/the-dog-guy-carl-liepmann-looks-back-on-his-long-list-of-accomplishments): Profile of dog trainer Carl Liepmann and his accomplishments in dog training and judging
- [National Reading Month at Thomas White Elementary](https://midmichigannow.com/news/local/national-reading-month-stories-with-kindergarten-students-at-thomas-white-elementary): Story about National Reading Month celebration at Thomas White Elementary in Saginaw
- [Potential Human Remains Found at Newly Purchased Home](https://midmichigannow.com/news/local/potential-human-remains-found-at-newly-purchased-home): Michigan State Police investigation into potential human remains in Forest Township
- [Former Kearsley Schools Substitute Teacher Acquitted of CSC Charges](https://midmichigannow.com/news/local/former-kearsley-schools-substitute-teacher-acquitted-of-csc-charges-criminal-sexual-conduct-burton-felony-charges): Court verdict on former Kearsley Schools substitute teacher Chad Mosher acquitted of charges
